name: Traveling Chess Club
notes: Welcome to Traveling Chess Club! A community-based chess club that travels to different locations to play. Our mission is to inspire more people to play chess over the board, whether they've played for years or have never played before. Weekly OTB (Over the board) games, socials and special events! Explore: Our chess club is all about exploring new places, new opponents, and new strategies. We believe that by venturing out and trying new things, we’ll continue to grow and improve as people and players. Play: Chess is a game of strategy and skill, and we believe in playing to win. Playing to your strengths can not only improve your skills in game but also in life. Live: For us, chess is more than just a game - it's a lifestyle. By embracing the lessons and values of the game, we strive to live our lives with integrity, focus, and determination. Learn more about us: https://www.travelingchess.com/ https://www.meetup.com/traveling-chess-club/ https://www.instagram.com/travelingchessclub/ https://linktr.ee/travelingchess

name: GenSpace Chess Club
notes: Welcome to our club! My name is Wolf and I manage the GenSpace Chess Club, found inside the Wallis Annenberg GenSpace . GenSpace is located in the heart of Los Angeles in Koreatown, one of the most ethnically diverse communities in the country. It’s on Level 3 of the stunning new Audrey Irmas Pavilion , designed by OMA. GenSpace is easily accessible by bus or the Metro D Line (formerly the Purple Line). https://audreyirmaspavilion.org/ The GenSpace Chess Club is where older adults can safely meet to learn and play chess inside our beautiful GenSpace facility. The GenSpace Chess Club meets in-person on Wednesdays, 12:00 pm - 3:00 pm. From beginners to Grand Masters – all are welcome! Come join us to connect with fellow chess enthusiasts and make new friends! GenSpace also offers many other daily programs, activities and events for all its members. You get chess and so much more! Click the link below to discover even more ways GenSpace can enrich your life. There’s no place in L.A. quite like it! https://www.annenberggenspace.org/ Chess Club Newcomers: Please call to make an appointment on Wednesdays between 12:30 pm - 2:30 pm to take a tour of GenSpace and to meet our friendly club members. Have questions about our chess club? Feel free to message me anytime. You may also click “Join” to become an online member for free and receive the latest chess club announcements, news and updates. For GenSpace questions, please call GenSpace to speak with our wonderful staff. GenSpace contact info can be found by clicking the link above. Thank you for your interest. I hope to see you soon! Wolf – GenSpace Chess Club manager
